svg.title: Program preparation has three stages before review
svg.desc: Opening and interpreting is displayed from zero to fifty percent, path preparation from fifty to one hundred percent, and preview preparation stays at one hundred percent. Only after completion do the normal controls return and the bar change to execution progress at zero. None of these stages starts the job.

g.text: Read the stage as well as the percentage
Conceptual loading guide — not a screenshot or a time scale
After successful preparation: review the accepted job
Open file returns. Read the file path, diagnostics, dimensions and setup information.
The same bar now shows execution progress and starts at 0%.
100% during loading does not mean machining is complete — or ready to start.
Run remains a separate operator request after the job and machine checks.
